subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should context-engine status/doctor/rotate become a public core Gateway API now, and if so should the accepted surface be Gateway RPC, HTTP-only, or plugin-owned?
rationale: The code can be repaired mechanically, but choosing a permanent Gateway/plugin API surface for control-plane rotation is a product and owner-boundary decision.

options.title: Accept with API alignment
options.body: Keep the feature only after discovery, dispatch, docs, and plugin ContextEngine contract semantics agree on the public surface.

options.title: Keep HTTP-only for now
options.body: Treat the routes as direct operator HTTP endpoints, hide the synthetic scope names from Gateway method discovery, and document them as full-operator HTTP surfaces.

options.title: Move out of core
options.body: Defer or close this core PR and ask the context-engine/plugin owner to expose control behavior through a plugin-owned surface until a broader core API is approved.

recommendation.title: Accept with API alignment
recommendation.body: Keep the feature only after discovery, dispatch, docs, and plugin ContextEngine contract semantics agree on the public surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The blocking mismatch sits in Gateway method discovery/scope policy, where this owner has the strongest recent history.
